name: gizza-ai/waveform-image
summary: Render a static waveform PNG image from an audio file

tool.description: Render a static waveform PNG image from an audio file (any format ffmpeg decodes: mp3, wav, flac, ogg, m4a, opus, ...). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). width x height set the image size in pixels (default 1200x300); color is the wave's #RRGGBB hex (default #4f46e5); background is an optional #RRGGBB hex (empty = transparent PNG); split_channels draws one lane per channel instead of a single mono wave; scale (lin|sqrt|cbrt|log) boosts quiet audio's visibility. Output is always a PNG image.

background.description: Background color as #RGB or #RRGGBB hex, e.g. #000000. Empty or omitted keeps the background transparent (the PNG has an alpha channel).

color.description: Waveform color as #RGB or #RRGGBB hex, e.g. #4f46e5 or #f00. Default #4f46e5.

height.description: Output image height in pixels, 16-2048. Default 300. With split_channels the height is divided across the channel lanes.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

scale.description: Amplitude scale. lin is the true waveform; sqrt, cbrt and log progressively boost quiet audio so it stays visible. Default lin.

split_channels.description: Draw each audio channel in its own horizontal lane instead of downmixing to one mono wave. Default false.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Output image width in pixels, 16-4096. Default 1200 (the common social-banner shape with the default height).
